description: Flapping 3D bird models for GeoLocator Explorer's bird view. glTF binary, one looping animation 'Fly', head +Y, back +Z (glTF), wingspan 0.5 units.

birds.method: A: make_bird.py image (nano-banana-pro) + model (standard textured 2k + underside texture prompt)
birds.notes: 2026-11-19; clean underside; Meshy added legs although the image had none -> folded by rig
birds.attribution: GeoPressure bird-models (Raphaël Nussbaumer), from huashu-bird-sticker illustrations by Huashu (CC BY 4.0)
